about: A-class files adopted with a known difference from the freeze commit, or whose removal was adopted (design doc 10, section 2.1). A difference pins the file's git blob hash, a removal pins "removed": true; each entry says why. The guard lets exactly that through, and any further edit is caught again.

core/checks/camera_view.py.why: design 27 (D89): v1 is gone and nothing in v2 reads this file - the camera-view hints of the frame-probe prompts; the video judge names the cameras itself

core/checks/task_success.py.why: design 27 (D89): v1 is gone and nothing in v2 reads this file - the frame-probe task-success judge (probes, end-state votes, arbitration); v2 judges task success from the continuous videos (pipeline/video_task.py, design 13)

core/task_type.py.why: design 27 (D89): v1 is gone and nothing in v2 reads this file - the persistent / transient task classification of the frame-probe prompts

dataset_level/audit.py.why: design 27 (D90): the label-conflict queue it built came from the label guard's holds, gone since D73; the merged label audit and label_audit.json went with it, and nothing else read the file

dataset_level/caption.py.why: design 27 (D89): v1 is gone and nothing in v2 reads this file - the v1 caption pass (one caption per episode for the skill profile and the label audit)

dataset_level/decisions.py.why: design 27 (D89): v1 is gone and nothing in v2 reads this file - the human-decision CSVs of v1's review page and `curation rejudge`; v2 adjudicates through the Daemon (adjudicate-apply)

dataset_level/profile.py.why: registry 3.0: the skill profile left the funnel - no module reads it any more, and the algorithm it carried has no caller (the label-conflict queue is now the kill guard's alone, dataset_level/audit.py)

dataset_level/reassign.py.why: registry 3.0: the skill profile left the funnel - no module reads it any more, and the algorithm it carried has no caller (the label-conflict queue is now the kill guard's alone, dataset_level/audit.py)

dataset_level/stuck_events.py.why: design 27 (D89): v1 is gone and nothing in v2 reads this file - the stuck-event list v1's run built for its report

dataset_level/taxonomy.py.why: registry 3.0: the skill profile left the funnel - no module reads it any more, and the algorithm it carried has no caller (the label-conflict queue is now the kill guard's alone, dataset_level/audit.py)

export/lerobot_writer.py.why: D69: the platform only produces the report, it no longer writes a delivery dataset - the LeRobot writer has no caller left (the mcap / rrd writers, the incremental re-export and the export command went with it; v1's own export raises through export/retired.py)

ingest/dsfs.py.why: the listing a command already has is handed to the readers (seed): one listing of the bucket per task instead of three per stage worker; no read path changes - prefetch, exists, glob and the reads are as they were (tests/cli test_the_bucket_is_listed_once_per_task)

ingest/mcap_reader.py.why: mcap streamed from TOS (no source cache): _effective_mapping / _scan_mcap / _payload take an optional open_fn, episode numbering delegates to streams.objects.number_episodes, the muxers accept a file-like sink; no algorithm change - streamed rows equal local rows byte for byte (tests/cli test_tos_mcap_is_streamed, test_episode_clips_are_the_readers_mp4_bytes)

ingest/schema.py.why: design 27 (D89): v1 is gone and nothing in v2 reads this file - the column-name constants of v1's Daft DataFrame (no v2 module imports them)

pipeline/verdict.py.why: design 27 (D89): v1 is gone and nothing in v2 reads this file - v1's hard-gate / soft-score verdict; v2 judges by policy over findings (pipeline/policy.py, pipeline/verdicts.py, design 17)

registry/fk.py.why: design 27 (D89): v1 is gone and nothing in v2 reads this file - a forward-kinematics wrapper for a self-collision check that never shipped (nothing imported it)

vlm_call_kinds.py.why: design 27 (D89, D90): only the call kinds v2 sends are named - probe (task_success's one request) and eef_review; v1's endstate, arbitration, caption and llm went with v1

ingest/dataset_profiles/_README.md.why: design 27 (D89): the profile fields are described by what v2 reads; the arbitration and camera_view.py readers went with v1 (documentation only)
